teamTint.note: Albedo is baked in the standard livery. Recolour pixels whose material map red channel matches these ids to apply an army livery.

liveries._note: Army liveries for runtime tinting of team materials. Mirrors src/renderer.js TEAM_COLORS and tools/voxel_pipeline/v3/materials.mjs ARMY_LIVERY.

composite.note: every part of one facing pre-composited through the shared ground anchor

lit.note: the composite re-shaded through a virtual three-point rig using the normal and material maps (key/fill/rim). If normals or PBR channels are wrong, this is where it shows.

previewLit.note: relit from the normal + material maps

previewLights.note: one virtual light per panel, proving the normal map is directionally correct
